title: GateFormer: Forecast-Space Decomposition for Intra-Hour Solar Irradiance Prediction from Sky Images
abstract: arXiv:2610.30942v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sub-hourly dispatch, balancing, and storage control increasingly depend on forecasts that anticipate rapid variability in solar generation. Accurate sky-image-based irradiance forecasting requires a combination of visual cloud dynamics with recent irradiance state while adapting to different short-term irradiance-change regimes. To address this, we introduce GateFormer, a GHI-conditioned dual-decoder ViT for intra-hour global horizontal irradiance (GHI) forecasting through forecast-space decomposition. GateFormer embeds observed GHI into the visual token stream, allowing interaction with sky-image patch features through self-attention. From this shared representation, a Trajectory Head predicts future GHI sequence, while a Delta Head predicts final-horizon change from the latest observed GHI. translated_title: GateFormer：基于预测空间分解的天空图像小时级内太阳辐照度预测
tldr: GateFormer提出了一种以GHI为条件的双解码器视觉Transformer，通过将观测辐照度嵌入视觉token流、进行预测空间分解并在预测空间中自适应加权融合轨迹与增量两类预测，实现了基于天空图像的更精准小时级内太阳辐照度预测。
en_tdlr: GateFormer is a GHI-conditioned dual-decoder ViT that embeds observed irradiance into the visual token stream and employs forecast-space decomposition with adaptive weighted fusion of trajectory and delta predictions for accurate intra-hour solar irradiance forecasting from sky images.
